text:
In my backpack
a little thyme stem
two coins
a blunt pencil
crumpled notes
cookie crumbs
a green clothespin
the business card of a Japanese Germanist
a small toothless comb
Dalí's ants on a sheet of music.

translation.title: In My Backpack...
